close_reason: Duplicate of fetcherc-9el.6 which covers the same scope.
description: CrestHttpClient.perform_request directly checks body.bytesize > SafeFeedProcessor::MAX_FEED_SIZE and raises InvalidFormatError. This is a SafeFeedProcessor concern, not an HTTP client concern. The check belongs in SafeFeedProcessor (or a wrapper invoked after perform_request returns). Refactor so CrestHttpClient does not import MAX_FEED_SIZE.
title: Move SafeFeedProcessor size check out of CrestHttpClient
